question: Bringer uses Tsunami with its threshold. Its base Damage would destroy a Town, so that Town is Pushed into an adjacent other Coastal land on the same board. Tsunami’s threshold later deals Damage in that land. Counting only nightmare-destruction Fear from that same Town, can it produce that Fear again during this single Tsunami use, or only once?
answer: Only once. Moving the same Town into another land affected later by this Tsunami does not reset the single-Power, single-Invader limit.

reason.source: Native original Bringer + native unmarked Tsunami; publisher expansion-identification legend.
reason.finding: Tsunami itself supplies both Damage instructions; Bringer itself supplies the immediate hypothetical-destruction conversion, Push, and per-Invader cap. CoreFAQ tags are not used as membership proof. No external modifier, trigger, extra Power use or unnamed effect is granted.

reason.source: Tsunami targeting bar and ordinary legal-state givens.
reason.finding: A Coastal target within Range2 of Bringer’s Sacred Site, paid cost6, met3Water2Earth threshold, a Town there, and another adjacent Coastal land on the SAME board are ordinary legal states. Counts, Elements, resources and locations do not introduce a foreign effect.

reason.source: Tsunami base8Damage; Bringer replacement; complete FAQ.7w4g7yx.
reason.finding: The base Damage would destroy the Town. At that would-destroy point, the real game gains nightmare Fear and Pushes the Town. The FAQ’s whenever conversion is inside this Power, not a Vengeance-style trigger deferred until the whole action finishes.

reason.source: Bringer Pushes all; CORE ordered effects, mandatory possible instructions and adjacent Push.
reason.finding: The possible Push is performed before proceeding to later card instructions. Its legal chosen adjacent Coastal destination is stipulated. The player may not freely decline that possible Push while carrying out the Power; the generic ability to forego the whole Power does not create a separate optional Push.

reason.source: Tsunami threshold printed other-Coastal/same-board footprint; CORE top-to-bottom threshold order.
reason.finding: After the base text, the threshold reaches that other Coastal land and has a4Damage instruction there. This is one Tsunami use; no First/Before exception reverses it. The Dahan-destruction instructions cannot harm Dahan under Bringer and do not cancel the remaining instructions.

reason.source: Bringer Notes: single Power cannot Destroy a given Invader more than once.
reason.finding: The same Town has already qualified once within this Power. Its relocation does not supply a new use or reset its identity. It therefore gives no second nightmare-destruction Fear from this Tsunami.
